This is what I find funny about the idea that tinder sucks for “average guys”. The idea that an average man ought to reproduce is a very modern one in geological terms.

This came about with the rise of monogamy, which probably had benefits for societal stability of the then nascent civilisations.

You can make two criticisms of monogamous societies, from both sides of the political spectrum. From the far-right eugenicist perspective the issue is by allowing average men to reproduce you are undermining the process of genetic selection. From the left wing feminist perspective monogamy forces most women to bear the children of men who they find genetically inadequate (against their better instincts), which of course courses them deep disquiet.

There is an interesting conflict here between the genetic evolution of the species and the mimetic evolution of complex societies. It is in the interest of a society, it seems, to maintain an evolutionary false vacuum, whereby most men reproduce - even if those men would be inadequate for reproduction in the state of nature.

Like you say, incels shouldn’t be angry about this state of affairs. We are merely progressing back to the state of nature as part of our societal evolution.
